title: Iron Golems' Revenge
description: Iron Golems will recognize you as the threat you are and attack you on sight. They'll also get EXTRA angry towards players only.
body:
Big guy works all day and all night to protect his villagers.

Now he's protecting them against the real threat.

YOU.

---

![Angry Iron Golem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8576e465dcf082023e009ef9afd64c362c62fc1.png)

---

He's seen what you've done. He's seen you trap his villagers. He's seen the "trading halls" and your methods of getting a discount. He's seen the thing with the end rod and the boat and the piston and the sheep. He will stand for this no longer. Don't be so sure your 3 block pillar will save you this time (it will). Good luck.

---

All naturally spawned and villager spawned iron golems will attack you when you enter their sight range: within around 15 blocks. 

Iron golems created by the player (using iron blocks and a pumpkin) will not.

To spawn in a "player created" in creative use the command:\
/summon iron_golem ~ ~ ~ {PlayerCreated:1b}\
or\
/give @p iron_golem_spawn_egg[entity_data={id:"minecraft:iron_golem",PlayerCreated:1b}] 1

---

Minecraft may ask you if you want use Experimental Settings, just press "I know what I'm doing."

Supports Multiplayer.

Made for Java 1.21.6.
